home.heroTitle: Don’t rush the choice — look first
home.heroBody: You don’t need to know the Three Arts. Bring an ordinary question: work, people, or timing. We draw a map of conditions. The decision stays yours.
home.pillarCalcDesc: Calendar and boards are reproducible — same inputs, same result.
home.pillarAiDesc: Every claim is sourced; disclosures when a model is used.
home.pillarDecideDesc: Host–guest framing clarifies stance; it never replaces judgment.
home.systemsBody: Forget memorizing old names. Pick the door that fits your question.
home.curiosityBody: Patterns, palaces, polarity — revealed in layers. The more you read, the more time and position interlock.

learn.lead: Three short stories. After them you can use the app — even if you’ve never heard of the Three Arts.
learn.path1.title: Host–guest frame
learn.path1.body: Who asks, who responds; position and time. Learn questions the board can answer.
learn.path2.title: Reading the board

home.ctaPricing: When you want to go deeper
home.pain1.title: Trying hard, still circling
home.pain1.body: New place, new method — the old feeling returns, like many applications and no reply.
home.pain2.title: Between two paths
home.pain2.body: Afraid of choosing wrong. You need a quiet picture, not a shout to act now.
home.pain3.title: Looks fine, feels tangled
home.pain3.body: You want to see where you are stuck — gently, without judgment.
home.diff.them2: No idea where claims come from
home.diff.us1: Same time and place — same picture
home.packagesBody: Today only needs one try. Go deeper when you’re ready — no pressure.
home.proofEmpty: We do not invent reviews. When someone consents to share, their story appears here.
home.faq1.a: No. It helps you slow down and see. Pictures follow classical rules; hints cite sources; the choice stays yours.
home.faq2.q: I know nothing about Qi Men…
home.faq2.a: That is fine. You only need a date-time and an everyday question. Quick guide uses examples — no memorizing.
home.faq3.a: Full maps, hints, save on your device. Paid packs are deeper layers — no pressure to buy.
home.faq4.a: Not sold. Pins stay in the browser; server accounts will have a clear policy.
home.faq5.a: Usually under a minute for a picture. Reading hints can be as slow as a short letter.
